direct_square_values.to_meaning: baseline (default): a gated ReLU exit is set to 0 (the unit is off) and an always-on exit to its training mean (its variation removed, its average kept); zero: every exit to 0 (for an always-on unit this also removes its average); mean: every exit to its training mean. Edges: zero sets the weight to 0; baseline and mean replace the edge's contribution by its training mean (moved into the target's bias).
